blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Association of Southeast Asian Nation (Asean) member-states have urged state forces and armed groups in Myanmar to de-escalate violence and stop targeted attacks against civilians and civilian infrastructure, as fighting continues in the said country after a military coup in 2021. In a document shared by the secretariat, Asean member-states stated in their review and decision on the implementation of the five-point consensus (5PC) for Myanmar that they are reaffirming the said peace plan’s full implementation so that the people will have “an inclusive and durable peaceful resolution” which will push for the “betterment of the people of […]...
